personnelNotes: The charter names only the Officer-in-Charge. Everyone else appears by role: GAD Staff, the GAD Focal Person, the GAD Focal Point System, and the GAD Technical Working Group of the office concerned.
The division is published under the City Mayor's Office.

feedbackMechanism.howToSendFeedback: Write to the office or email gadlegazpihb1@gmail.com. You can also call 0912 158 3909.
feedbackMechanism.howFeedbackIsProcessed: To complain, write on the Complaint Form (CSC Form No. 3) or email, giving your full name, address and contact information, an account of the complaint, any evidence, and the name of the person being complained about. Complaints are processed and acted on, and the outcome is communicated to the complainant by email or by phone.

services.title: Asking for GAD information or a referral
services.description: Information on gender and development concerns, and referral to the agency or department that can help where the matter is beyond the division's mandate. How long the information takes depends on whether it is already to hand.
services.whoMayAvail: General public, private sectors and residents of Legazpi City

requirements.item: Written request, by email or hard copy
Visitor's attendance form, for walk-in clients

steps.agency: Receives and records the written request.
Refers the concern to the GAD Focal Person for clarification and proper action.
Advises you on the appropriate action to take and refers you to the agency or institution with the mandate or competence to give the assistance you need.

Releases the information. A simple transaction is GAD-related information or data already readily available; a complex one is information not readily available, needing review and approval by the appropriate authorities before release; a highly technical one needs further research, consultation with other stakeholders, processing of raw tables from available databases, or review and approval by the GAD Focal Point System.
steps.processingTime: 3 days for a simple transaction, 7 days for a complex one, 15 days for a highly technical one
steps.personResponsible: GAD Staff / GAD Focal Point System

notes: How long you wait depends on the information, not on you: three days if the division already holds it, up to fifteen if it has to be researched or cleared first.
The charter gives the service's availability as eight hours and its email as gadlegazpihb1@gmail.com.
